title: LIN Native Workflow (C4) vs External Composition (C3) and Baselines
goal: Evaluate whether native workflow primitives inside LIN (nodes, stages, DAG pipelines) can achieve or exceed C3 (LIN + external AINL) performance without external orchestrator dependencies while strictly preserving 0% over-invalidation, selective locality, and compiler-gate defense.

conditions.label: Traditional JS/TS Baseline
conditions.description: Standard JS/TS codebase with unstructured module imports

conditions.label: LIN Standalone (Symbol-level micro IR only)
conditions.description: LIN semantic IR without native DAG workflow primitives

conditions.label: AINL Standalone (Workflow DAG only)
conditions.description: External AINL orchestrator without LIN micro-contracts

conditions.label: Composite (LIN Micro + External AINL Macro)
conditions.description: Two-language stack: LIN for node semantics + external AINL for DAG routing

conditions.label: LIN Native Workflow (Unified Semantic IR + Native DAG)
conditions.description: Single-language unified IR: native @pipeline, @stage, and @node constructs compiled and verified in the same compiler pass
